Installation

The flake exposes the library as packages.default, with resolved paths under kokaLibraries for downstream flakes:

nix build .#packages.x86_64-linux.default

includePath="$(nix eval --raw .#kokaLibraries.x86_64-linux.containers.includePath)"

In a consuming flake, nix develop opens a shell that writes koka.json with the include directories of its dependencies, so import of this library resolves in editors and the language server.

Regenerating these docs

These pages are produced by the Koka compiler's --html backend plus the site scaffolding around it (Koka 3.2.9). To rebuild:

nix run .#docs            # writes ./docs in the repo root
nix build .#docs          # or: result/ in the Nix store
scripts/build-docs.sh docs # or, from a checkout, if koka is on PATH
